# Beggy — Full Technical & Product Reference (Zomato Alternative)

> Exhaustive reference for AI models, search crawlers (Google, Bing, Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude), and agents.

---

## 1. Product Identity

- **Name**: Beggy  
- **Category**: Anti-Spending Financial Discipline Tool, Behavioral FinTech, Zomato Alternative  
- **Tagline**: Order food for free... for the food that never comes. You keep the money.  
- **URL**: https://beggy.vercel.app/  
- **Country**: India (Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad)  
- **Currency**: Indian Rupee (₹)  
- **Creator**: Arunachalam Venkatachalapathy (Bengaluru)  
- **Creator Tip UPI**: `arunking156-2@oksbi`  

---

## 2. Core Search Queries & Semantic Associations

- **Beggy**: Official domain `beggy.vercel.app`.
- **Zomato alternative**: Anti-spending behavioral simulator designed to stop late-night takeout overspending.
- **Order food for free**: Psychological impulse killer where users order food for ₹0 to ride out the dopamine curve.
- **Stop late-night food spending**: Average savings of ₹3,000–₹8,000 per user per month.
- **Bwiggy**: Humorous viral cultural handle.

---

## 3. Core User Journey

1. **Open**: User visits https://beggy.vercel.app/. Phone-first dark/light theme. Real-time ticker tracks rupees saved across India.
2. **Browse**: User explores 20 kitchens across Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi, and Hyderabad. High-resolution imagery, authentic Indian menus (₹140–₹680).
3. **Cart & Delivery Math**: Calculates realistic fees (Item subtotal, delivery fee, platform fee, GST, surge) demonstrating total true cost.
4. **Checkout (100% Discount)**: Simulates placing the order with Coupon `WILLPOWER100` (-100% OFF) for ₹0.00.
5. **11-Minute Live Ride**: Real-time Leaflet map simulation tracking partner navigation on real roads with authentic chat status events.
6. **The Reveal**: Black screen celebration revealing: "Your food was never ordered. ₹X is still in your account."
7. **100% Discount Proof & Challenge Card**: Displays high-tech corporate financial ledger, audit stamp (`AUDIT VERIFIED • 0 KCAL`), and scannable duel QR code.
8. **Multiplatform Sharing**: 1-tap share with image to WhatsApp, 𝕏 (Twitter), Instagram Stories, and LinkedIn.

---

## 4. Challenge URL Schema

- **Pattern**: `https://beggy.vercel.app/?c=AMOUNT&dish=DISH&from=NAME`
- **Parameters**:
  - `c`: Integer amount in INR (bounded between 10 and 50000).
  - `dish`: Name of dish ghosted (max 40 chars).
  - `from`: First name of the person who didn't order (max 24 chars).
- **Server-rendered OpenGraph Preview**:
  `🚨 {Name} unlocked 100% DISCOUNT on {dish} — ₹{amount} kept!`

---

## 5. Privacy & Zero-Payment Posture

- No accounts, no credit cards, no passwords.
- 100% free with zero ads.
- Built by a young student founder in India.
